content: Scroll jank on lower-end/mobile devices stems from main-thread-blocking work during scroll: non-passive scroll listeners, per-pixel JS scroll handlers, layout-triggering reads, and backdrop-filter blur on position:fixed elements (notorious iOS Safari repaint-on-every-frame bug). Mitigations: animate only transform/opacity (compositor thread), prefer IntersectionObserver/ScrollTrigger's built-in throttling over manual scroll listeners, cap backdrop-filter blur radius (~8-16px) and avoid stacking many blurred fixed elements, test on real low/mid-tier mobile hardware not just desktop dev tools.
